barefoot.linePrev: I love everybody because I love you
barefoot.line: When you stood up, walked away barefoot
barefoot.lineNext: And the grass where you lay left a bed in your shape
stanza: I love everybody because I love you
When you stood up, walked away barefoot
And the grass where you lay left a bed in your shape
I looked over it and I ached

barefoot.line: Standing barefoot on a cold wood floor
barefoot.lineNext: Looking out the window of my back door
stanza: Standing barefoot on a cold wood floor
Looking out the window of my back door
If it keeps on raining
I think the whole damn house is going to float away
The alarm was buzzing at the break of dawn
My husband's asking, "Is the coffee on?"
And easy's getting harder every day

barefoot.linePrev: There were wet leaves floating in gutters full of rain
barefoot.line: Took to walking barefoot around town
barefoot.lineNext: Melodies from grade school, kicking in my brain
stanza: Autumn came around like a drifter to an onramp
There were wet leaves floating in gutters full of rain
Took to walking barefoot around town
Melodies from grade school, kicking in my brain
Saw you on the crosstown bus today
You were reading a magazine
I turned my face away and I shut my eyes tight
And dreamed about the flowers that hide from the light on dark hillsides
In the hidden places

barefoot.linePrev: Well, the maximum lawman run down Flamingo
barefoot.line: Chasing the Rat and the barefoot girl
barefoot.lineNext: And the kids 'round here look just like shadows
stanza: Well, the maximum lawman run down Flamingo
Chasing the Rat and the barefoot girl
And the kids 'round here look just like shadows
Always quiet, holding hands
From the churches to the jails
Tonight, all is silence in the world
As we take our stand
Down in Jungleland

barefoot.linePrev: And I was catchin' my breath
barefoot.line: Barefoot in the wildest winter, catchin' my death
stanza: And I was catchin' my breath
Barefoot in the wildest winter, catchin' my death
And I couldn't be sure
I had a feeling so peculiar
That this pain would be for
Evermore

barefoot.line: Barefoot girl sitting on the hood of a Dodge
barefoot.lineNext: Drinking warm beer in the soft summer rain
stanza: The Rangers had a homecoming
In Harlem late last night
And the Magic Rat drove his sleek machine
Over the Jersey state line
Barefoot girl sitting on the hood of a Dodge
Drinking warm beer in the soft summer rain
The Rat pulls into town, rolls up his pants
Together, they take a stab at romance and disappear down Flamingo Lane

barefoot.linePrev: While all the women came and went
stanza: All along the watchtower
Princes kept the view
While all the women came and went
Barefoot servants too
Outside, in the distance
A wildcat did growl
Two riders were approaching
The wind began to howl
